# mk substitutes $name in a recipe before the shell runs it, using its own
# variables and the environment, so an environment variable can override a
# variable the recipe sets itself. $$name is passed to the shell as $name.
env name=alice
mk -p 1 -f mkfile
stdout '^plain alice$'
stdout '^escaped bob$'

-- mkfile --
greet:V:
	name=bob
	echo plain $name
	echo escaped $$name
